mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, c.content, c.created_at FROM article_comment c JOIN user_account u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article_comment c WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0
